name: Shark Dating Simulator
source:
As a new graduate of Scuba School, your underwater mad skills are for hire, as you seek adventure and romance. Along with your charming boss Marina Fishpaste, take to the high seas to discover a love like you never expected in the form of a Tsundere Shark. Will you help her or harm her?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/666020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
作为刚从潜水学校毕业的新人，你靠出租水下超凡技能谋生，寻找冒险与恋情。和迷人的老板玛丽娜·鱼酱一起驶向大海，发现一种从未预料的爱情——对象是一条傲娇鲨鱼。你会帮助她，还是伤害她？

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/666020/]Steam[/url]]
